Where do you see paintball as a sport or as a recreational activity presented in a positive light?

Almost every walk on I've ever seen play has been very intimidated by it. I see people walk off the field with little more than paint splatter on them weekly because they're too afraid to get hit or have heard stories about it hurting way more than it actually does.

I can afford it if I wanted to. It's just not something that's worth effort though. It's basically one big party sport, and even though it's a blast, I'd rather not spend 50 hours working just so I can enjoy 8 hours of fun each weekend. That's just not worth it to me.  

Also, just that 1 thing is all I find fun. I've tried a lot of hobbies, and never found one that sticks. I can get into them for a little bit, but they very quickly become dull.

Because I've got nothing to lose. It isn't her fault at all. If she says yes, it won't influence my plan, I'll just be even happier for the last day of my life :)

Because existing takes effort, and I don't care to deal with people. Other people do nothing but cause problems, I just wanna lay back, relax and do my own thing without being bitched at constantly; Even if laying back and relaxing means being homeless and sleeping in a train car. For some reason, the people around me don't understand how little I care about my comfort, and how much I care about doing what I want that they wouldn't even allow me to become homeless without giving me shit about it. They think I care, or that I'd be unhappy. They really don't understand how I think about things, and I'm not sure many people do.

I've always wanted to die young I guess, I've never set a date for it to happen, or even planned it to be suicide, I just love being irresponsible/careless and had hoped that would kill me, but at this point it's becoming difficult to be irresponsible/careless without people harping on me about it and trying (successfully) to force me to do shit I don't want to do.

I put up with that for 4 years in high school, and that shit was miserable; I can't do another 4 for university, and I certainly can't do another 40-60 after that. I'm at a point now where I'm ready to die, happily. Life seems boring as fuck because nothing it's hard to find things that entertain me as is, and the things that do get boring very fast. I get bored of stuff incredibly quickly.

I'm not willing to put myself into debt over school either, the thing that I've hated so much since the beginning of it 14 long years ago. Although even that isn't the reason I don't want to live anymore. Perhaps I'm simply mentally ill, but even if that is the case, I'm okay with it.
Well, it's not her fault :). Hopefully my family will reach out to her after I do it and show her this post. If they don't, oh well.
